notes: This dataset contains reproduction material for the paper "Embedded Trefftz discontinuous Galerkin methods". The dataset contains Python files used to produce the results in the paper a docker image with everything pre-installed. To run the python files outside the docker a running installation of NGSolve and NGSTrefftz is required. They are tested with NGSolve@e9e5d06, NGSTrefftz@v0.0.1. The Helmholtz problem additionally uses Hankel functions provided by ngs-special-functions. All the required software and python files are pre-installed and ready to run in the docker image. Start the docker using docker load < ./embtrefftz_docker.tar.gz docker run -it embtrefftz /bin/bash
